text:
Nora (VP Eng): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the reliability RCA. link: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-24/ttl-rollup (internal). posting owners & short actions here so we can close the loop.

Sam (SRE): read the RCA. mitigation summary sounds right. can someone confirm who owns the canary cadence and rollback thresholds?

Nora (VP Eng): Sam owns the rollout. plan in doc: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 30m windows, rollback on error-rate > 1%. Sam, pls post runbook snippet.

Priya (Product): PM request: prepare a one-line Console timeline entry + short support FAQ. Omar can you coordinate outreach?

Omar (Support): yes — need affected org list and exact impact window. where is that in the RCA?

Nora (VP Eng): impact is in RCA “Impact & Scope”: ~30m elevated p99/tail for ~8% of dedicated-routed requests between 05:10–05:40 UTC. RCA attachments include org export; i'll DM support.

Leah (Platform): i'll add KV-cache miss panel to the Console and wire the new metric path (inference.kv_cache.miss_ratio). ETA 48h.

Sam (SRE): adding a preflight smoke script to validate TTL behavior before full purge. i'll post link here when done. owner: Sam.

Priya (Product): product note for roadmap: flag "KV observability" for Optimize backlog as priority P2.

Nora (VP Eng): i've added an actions table in the RCA: Sam (rollout + script), Leah (dashboards + metric), Priya (console blurb + roadmap), Omar (support comms). please reply to confirm by EOD.

inc-bot: checklist item created in RCA and assigned to owners.

Sam (SRE): confirmed. will post runbook snippet & script link shortly.

Leah (Platform): confirmed. will update dashboards and notify Console team.

Omar (Support): confirmed. waiting on org export.

Priya (Product): confirmed. drafting console copy now.

Nora (VP Eng): leadership asked for a 30m blameless review next week to go over timeline and lessons — i'll send the invite. any blockers call them out here.

Sam (SRE): small ask: include deploy metadata in the RCA header (build id + pool) so audits are easier.

Nora (VP Eng): good idea — adding now. thanks team for the quick sync; RCA is single source of truth for follow-ups.

Priya (Product): posting proposed Console line: "Brief latency increase for a subset of routed requests; engineers deployed a fix and measures are in place to prevent recurrence." feel free to shorten.

Omar (Support): that reads fine. i'll use it in support messages once i have the org list.

inc-bot: deploy to canary pool gpux-dedicated-4 (canary=10%) started by Sam — build 2026.03.24-ttl-rollup.

Sam (SRE): canary healthy at 10% after 30m. bumping to 40% now. will monitor burn-rates and post updates.

Nora (VP Eng): thanks all. will update the all-hands follow-up doc later today with confirmed ETAs.
